equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.description: Discover HARUYOUNG Clinic’s equipment for skin & body diagnosis, redness and pigmentation, acne, scars and pores, tightening and lifting, skin care and body care.
equipment.subtitle: HARUYOUNG equipment that begins with an accurate diagnosis

skin.title: Skin & Body Diagnosis
skin.about:
Your skin and body hold far more information than what meets the eye.
HARUYOUNG’s Skin & Body Diagnosis focuses first on precisely analyzing what lies beneath the surface, including hydration, elasticity and pigmentation in the skin, along with body composition data such as body fat and muscle mass.
Based on accurate results from the Meta-Vu device, we find the treatment and care plan that truly fits you now, for natural, lasting improvement.
skin.device: We precisely analyze everything from skin hydration, elasticity and pigmentation to body fat and body balance, and find the treatment that’s exactly right for you now.

redness.title: Redness · Pigmentation
redness.about:
Redness and dull pigmentation often appear together even though their causes differ, so it’s important to tell them apart precisely. Rather than treating the visible redness and pigmentation together,
HARUYOUNG focuses first on precisely analyzing the underlying cause, whether it’s the blood vessels or pigment buildup.
A step-by-step approach tailored to your skin condition helps achieve a clear, comfortable skin tone.
redness.device: Calms redness-prone, sensitive blood vessels and skin, restoring comfortable, trouble-free skin.

scar.title: Acne · Scars · Pores
scar.about:
Recurring acne, the deep scars it leaves behind, and enlarged pores don’t heal on their own over time, and can even make the skin’s texture look rougher. Rather than simply covering up acne, scars
and pores on the surface, HARUYOUNG focuses first on regenerating the cause of inflammation, the damaged tissue and the structure around the pores together.
A personalized approach suited to your skin condition helps achieve smooth, refined skin texture.
scar.device: Regenerates recurring acne, deep-set scars and enlarged pores at the root, restoring smooth, refined skin texture.

tight.title: Tightening · Lifting
tight.about:
Over time, skin loses elasticity and begins to sag, blurring the overall facial contour.
Rather than simply concealing surface sagging, HARUYOUNG’s Tightening & Lifting care focuses first on restoring collagen production and the supportive structure deep within the skin.
With energy levels customized to the degree of sagging in each area, we help you achieve a firm, natural-looking contour.
tight.device: Stimulates skin that has lost firmness and sagged, tightening it into a firm, contoured facial line.

sooth.title: Soothing · Regeneration
sooth.about:
Irritated, tired skin needs both time and direction to recover.
Rather than offering only temporary relief, HARUYOUNG’s Soothing & Regeneration care focuses first on restoring the damaged skin barrier and the skin’s own regenerative capacity.
By combining ingredients and treatments suited to your skin condition, we help you achieve smooth, healthy skin texture.
sooth.device: Stabilizes irritated, tired skin while smoothing and brightening rough, dull skin texture.

mole.title: Mole · Wart Removal
mole.about:
Moles and warts can only be cleared cleanly, without scarring, when the removal method is matched to their location and depth.
Rather than simple removal, HARUYOUNG focuses first on precisely assessing the depth of the lesion and your skin type.
With treatment tailored to each area, we help you achieve clear skin with no worry of scarring.
mole.device: Cleanly removes unwanted moles and warts using a precise method matched to their size and location.

body.title: Body Contouring
body.about:
Localized fat and sagging lines often can’t be resolved through exercise alone.
Rather than focusing on simple volume reduction, HARUYOUNG’s Body Contouring focuses first on a plan that considers both fat distribution and skin elasticity for each area.
With an approach tailored to your body type, we help you achieve a balanced, natural silhouette.
body.device: Smooths and balances not only the face but also body lines such as the arms and abdomen.
